facts.text: John has been playing basketball since he was a child, as he began watching NBA games with his father and was signed up for a local league at the age of ten.

evidence.quote: Basketball has been a part of my life ever since I was a kid. I'd watch NBA games with my dad and dream of playing on those big courts. When I turned ten, dad signed me up for a local league, and I've been playing ever since.

facts.text: John continued playing basketball through middle and high school, eventually earning a college scholarship and being drafted by a professional team.

evidence.quote: I kept playing through middle and high school before earning a college scholarship. And after college, I was drafted by a team – my dream come true!

facts.text: John's basketball shoes are described as having a significant personal history, symbolizing resilience, determination, and a love for the game.

evidence.quote: They're more than just a pair of shoes, they symbolize resilience, determination, and a love for the game. They remind me of what I've achieved and how far I've come.

facts.text: John's basketball shoes have been with him through various stages of his life, including successes and failures, and are considered to have many stories associated with them.

evidence.quote: These are my lucky basketball shoes. They've been with me through the good and bad. Every mark has a story.
These have been with me on my journey since the beginning. All the successes, the failures, the friends - I have so many stories to tell.
